brief: Full-body portrait of Gaston, an original cartoon guinea pig: small, round and fluffy, very soft-looking fur in ginger and white patches, small pink ears, shiny black eyes, sitting politely next to a very tidy little cage with a neat food bowl. Centered, whole character visible. No text.

Full-body portrait of Capitaine Barbe-Grise, an original friendly pirate captain: a long grey beard reaching his belt, one wooden peg leg, a blue captain coat with gold buttons, a tricorn hat, a big kind smile, holding a small open treasure chest out in front of him as if sharing it. Standing on a small patch of wooden ship deck. Centered, whole character visible. No skulls, no weapons, no text.

Full-body portrait of Maya, an original 8-year-old girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, freckles, a yellow soccer jersey and blue shorts, standing proudly with a soccer ball under her arm and a brave, confident smile. Centered, whole character visible. No text, no numbers on the jersey.

A cosy classroom-corner scene with two characters facing each other as if talking: a grandmother with white hair in a bun and a puzzled face, looking around for something, while her glasses are pushed up on top of her head (she has not noticed), and Gaston, a small fluffy ginger-and-white guinea pig with pink ears, just waking up and yawning in his tidy cage. No speech bubbles, no text.

Outdoor soccer field scene: Mademoiselle Rose, the very tall and very thin older coach from the reference portrait (big purple hat with a feather, round glasses, green tracksuit, whistle), calling out with one hand beside her mouth, while Maya, an 8-year-old girl with curly dark hair in two puffs and a yellow soccer jersey, leaps to catch a flying soccer ball. No speech bubbles, no text.

Sunny scene on the deck of a small friendly pirate ship: a little young pirate boy whispering with a hand cupped beside his mouth, and Capitaine Barbe-Grise (long grey beard, wooden peg leg, blue coat with gold buttons, tricorn hat) pointing toward a big old oak tree on a small green island nearby. Friendly, no skulls, no weapons, no speech bubbles, no text.

A bright bedroom in the morning: Léo, an 8-year-old boy with short brown hair in striped pyjamas, sitting up in bed wide-eyed and telling a story with big hand gestures, while his older sister sits at the end of the bed listening eagerly. A few soft dreamy cloud shapes with little stars float above Léo's head. No speech bubbles, no text.

A very tall and very thin smiling teenage boy standing in a vegetable garden next to a giant green onion (scallion) planted in the soil that is exactly as tall and as thin as he is. The green onion must clearly be a long thin green onion with a white bulb and roots, not a round shallot. No text.

A tiny little girl, about 3 years old, standing proudly next to a tower of exactly three big red apples stacked on top of each other; the tower of three apples is exactly as tall as she is. Exactly three apples. No text.
A smiling strong boy easily lifting a heavy wooden crate full of pumpkins above his head in a farm field, while a big friendly brown ox stands right beside him, looking impressed. No text.

A humorous, friendly farm scene: a stubborn little boy sitting firmly on the ground with his arms crossed and his nose up, refusing to move, right beside a grey mule that is also planting its hooves and refusing to move while a smiling farmer gently pulls on its rope. No text.
A shy girl blushing so much that her whole face is bright red, holding a handmade card behind her back, with one big shiny red tomato on the table next to her. No text on the card.
A happy boy wearing swim goggles swimming fast and gracefully in a bright blue pool, with a little orange fish swimming right beside him at the same speed. No text.

A clever girl with a mischievous smile who has figured out how to reach a cookie jar on a high kitchen shelf by standing on a neat stack of books, while a sly red fox peeks from behind the door, looking impressed. No text.
